subject: College Tea with Geoff Chatas, Yale COO
text:
Dear Sillimanders,

Please join us for a College Tea with Geoff Chatas, Yale's Chief Operating Officer, on Wednesday, October 28, 5:00-6:30pm, at the Head of College House, 71 Wall St.

He will talk about how the university actually runs, and take your questions.

Warmly,
The Head of College Office
